name: lightcone
description: Core workflow for a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis with the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain: `new` scopes a new analysis from a research question, `report` authors the MyST report that references astra.yaml elements by path, `cli` carries the lc execution reference (spec–code invariant, status interpretation, failure diagnosis), and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Bundles the astra reference — and with it the astra hooks (session primer, validate-on-save, activate-on-read) — so this one plugin is all you need for interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project.
